[b]You can now care for Chinchillas as livestock![/b]

These mountain-dwelling rodents are known as one of the softest animals in the world, with 60+ hairs [i]per follicle[/i]. By keeping some in your coop, you can harvest the fur they drop as wool!

Mechanically, chinchillas act as a mid-point between rabbits and sheep: producing wool drops a little more frequently than rabbits, living in the coop, and without needing to be sheered, at the cost of not dropping rabbit's feet.

I sincerely hope you enjoy adding these jumpy little furballs to your farm!
